scope: Conditional BH finite-encounter versus matched diffusion residence pilot in the NGC5139 reference; not calibrated cluster transport or a test of the first-response predictor
host_selection: Same verified conditional reference as collisionless-residence-1; selected for its largest baseline BH encounter integral, before computing collisional outcomes
gravity: Frozen spherical potential of all physical host species; no remnant self-gravity or population response
lighter_species_collisions: Disabled identically in both arms; their smooth gravity is retained
external_force: Omitted inside the prior 1-percent force domain; the smaller table domain is a numerical stop, not escape

launch.interpretation: Conditional diagnostic total velocities, not a merger population or recoil-only law

kernel.fine_grid: Insert midpoint in every coarse interval on all three axes
kernel.interpolation: Nonnegative multilinear mixture of full vertex jump rate measures; identical weights for rate,A,raw D and excluded flux; event vertex chosen proportional to weight times allowed rate
kernel.symmetry: Enforce exact physical symmetry at zero speed, zero radius and radial velocity; apply same symmetry averaging to moments and sampled increments
kernel.quadrature_frame: Relative velocity w, full shifted field-DF support, sinh radial scale min sqrt(s2j)
kernel.holdout_scope: Predeclared random interior queries and near-radial/tangential pitch controls; compare against direct refined local integration, retain all errors
kernel.validation_interpretation: Moment checks do not establish full increment-law or residence convergence; grid sensitivity is tested through independent trajectory ensembles

transport.scheme: Freeze collision law at step start; exponential excluded-event clock shortens delta; two deterministic velocity-Verlet half flows surround one Gaussian or frozen-law compound-Poisson velocity increment; exact chord occupation in each drift
transport.diffusion_increment: Mean A*delta and covariance D*delta; D is raw second jump moment per time
transport.jump_increment: Sum N independent increments from same numerical mixture, N Poisson(Gamma*delta); no one-event cap
transport.random_streams: Independent arms and settings. Separate Gaussian, excluded-hazard, count and event streams. Fixed-shape Gaussian and hazard draws retain independent paths; no paired uncertainty claim
transport.excluded_channel: Common-law unresolved-event stop at its sampled time; not capture probability
transport.spatial_stop: Minimum of radius-table edge and inherited isolated-force domain; numerical-validity censoring, not physical escape
transport.velocity_stop: First resolved exit from speed-table domain; numerical-validity censoring with step refinement
transport.boundary_ordering: Earliest resolved spatial/velocity stop before excluded clock; record cause and remaining unmodeled duration
transport.occupation: All visits to r<r_rho, divided by the full declared horizon, including killed paths
transport.exposure: BH mass-density integral normalized by central BH mass density and full horizon

reporting.inference: Independent-ensemble standard errors for bounded mean observables; two-sample DKW bounds for residence CDF differences; binomial intervals for stopping probabilities. Pilot intervals are descriptive, not simultaneous coverage across every comparison
reporting.grid_and_time: Report both refinement shifts with sampling uncertainty; do not label convergence from an unresolved difference
reporting.missing_residence: For numerical domain stops, (H-stop_time)/H bounds omitted future residence pathwise; report empirical bound plus uncertainty
reporting.outcome: Retain inconclusive or unresolved comparisons. No automatic claim of physical diffusion adequacy or hypothesis confirmation

first_response_prediction: Not evaluated in this numerical pilot; estimator is fixed independently in analysis/encounters/response.py. A later predeclared validation sample is required for predictor accuracy.
